KSI Name: Configure ALL information resources to limit inbound and outbound traffic
Requirement Text: Paramify must configure all information resources to limit inbound and outbound traffic to the minimum required.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - Inbound SG Allowlist for Internet-Exposed, Outbound Port Allowlist, SG Inbound no 0.0.0.0/0 other than HTTPS
Assessor Overview:
Paramify utilizes a bash script to pull the security group configurations which govern inbound and outbound rules for AWS resources. All configured security groups are polled and JSON output details direction, protocol, from port, to port and CIDRs.
Only approved security groups (ALB/NLB sg-0f64, sg-0a1c, sg-05d1) have inbound rules open to 0.0.0.0/0.
Evidence Reviewed: AWS security group export 2026-01-12; validator run history

KSI Name: Design configurations to minimize the attack surface
Requirement Text: Design configurations to minimize the attack surface and minimize lateral movement if compromised.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - Minimum Assessment Scope AWS, WAF Rules Configured
Assessor Overview: Interviewed the platform lead on 2026-01-13. Network is segmented into public, private and data subnets; no direct path from the public subnet to the database tier.
Evidence Reviewed: VPC subnet diagram; route table export
Recommendation: Document the subnet design in the SSP network section.

KSI Name: Use logical networking and related capabilities
Requirement Text: Use logical networking and related capabilities to enforce traffic flow controls.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - WAF DoS Rules, WAF CloudWatch Metrics Enabled, WAF IP Reputation List Enabled
Assessor Overview: WAF is attached to the public ALB with AWS managed rule groups enabled. CloudWatch metrics confirm rules are evaluating traffic.
Evidence Reviewed: AWS WAF WebACL export; CloudWatch metric screenshots

Requirement Text: Use immutable infrastructure with strictly defined functionality and privileges by default.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - Container Image Digest Pinning
Assessor Overview: Container images are rebuilt on every deploy from a pinned base image. However, two long-running EC2 bastion hosts are patched in place rather than replaced.
Evidence Reviewed: ECS task definitions; EC2 instance launch times
Gaps: Bastion hosts are mutable and patched in place, which does not meet the immutable infrastructure expectation.
Recommendation: Replace the bastion hosts with an image-based, auto-replaced instance group or SSM Session Manager.

Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - WAF DoS Rules, AWS Shield Standard
Assessor Overview: AWS Shield Standard is active on the account and WAF rate-based rules limit requests per source IP.
Evidence Reviewed: Shield console screenshot; WAF rate rule export

KSI Name: Design systems for high availability and rapid recovery
Requirement Text: Design systems for high availability and rapid recovery.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - Multi-AZ RDS, ECS Service Desired Count
Assessor Overview: RDS runs Multi-AZ and the ECS service runs across two availability zones. A failover test of the database succeeded in 48 seconds. The ECS service failover was not tested during this assessment window.
Gaps: ECS service failover was not exercised; only the database failover was tested.
Recommendation: Schedule a full-stack failover exercise and retain the results as evidence.

KSI Name: Ensure cloud-native architecture and design is documented
Requirement Text: Ensure cloud-native architecture and design is documented and assessed regularly.
Assessor Overview: Architecture diagrams are maintained in the SSP and were last reviewed on 2025-12-02.

Requirement Text: Enforce phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all user authentication.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - Okta Passwordless Authentication Policy, Okta FIDO2 Enrollment
Assessor Overview: Okta sign-on policy requires FIDO2 WebAuthn for all staff. Tested a sign-in attempt with password only, which was rejected.
Evidence Reviewed: Okta policy export; sign-in attempt log

KSI Name: Use secure passwordless methods for user authentication
Requirement Text: Use secure passwordless methods for user authentication and authorization when feasible.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - Okta Passwordless Authentication Policy
Assessor Overview: Passwordless is enforced for the production Okta org.

KSI Name: Enforce appropriately secure authentication methods for non-user accounts
Requirement Text: Enforce appropriately secure authentication methods for non-user accounts and services.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - AWS IAM Users and Groups, AWS IAM Policy
Assessor Overview: Service accounts use IAM roles with short-lived credentials. One legacy IAM user (ci-deployer) still holds a long-lived access key last rotated 2024-11-03.
Gaps: Long-lived access key on the ci-deployer IAM user, rotated over 12 months ago.
Recommendation: Migrate ci-deployer to an OIDC-federated role and delete the access key.

KSI Name: Use a least-privileged, role and attribute-based access model
Requirement Text: Use a least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time security authorization model.
Assessor Overview: Interviewed the security lead. Access is granted through Okta groups mapped to IAM roles; elevated roles expire after 8 hours.
Evidence Reviewed: Okta group membership export; IAM role session duration settings

Gaps: Not assessed in Phase One; deferred to the Phase Two window.

KSI Name: Operate a SIEM or similar system
Requirement Text: Operate a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or similar system(s) for centralized, tamper-resistant logging.
Automation Capability: Paramify Validator - CloudWatch Log Group Retention, CloudTrail Multi-Region
Assessor Overview: CloudTrail is enabled in all regions and delivers to a locked S3 bucket with object lock. Logs forward to Datadog.
Evidence Reviewed: CloudTrail configuration; S3 object lock settings

Assessor Overview: Weekly log review tickets exist for October through December 2025. The first two weeks of January 2026 have no review ticket.
Evidence Reviewed: Jira log-review tickets LR-41 to LR-52
Gaps: Two weekly reviews missing in January 2026.
Recommendation: Add a recurring Jira automation so the weekly review ticket is created automatically.
